text: {"label": "Assessment and Treatment of Rumination","definition": "Assessment and treatment of rumination (repeated regurgitation and rechewing of food), often in individuals with autism, using satiation, noncontingent reinforcement, punishment, gum chewing, or self-administered interventions; includes some work on depressive rumination.","distinct_from_neighbours": "Targets regurgitation-based rumination rather than food refusal or other inappropriate mealtime behavior, laboratory avoidance responding, or verbal and intraverbal stimulus control."}
